free_tier_limits.notes: Free trial mentioned in docs navigation but no permanent free tier documented in TOS. Trial credits are promotional and subject to expiration.

tos_analysis.license_scope: Non-sublicensable, non-transferable, non-exclusive subscription for Customer's internal use only. Explicit prohibition on sublicensing or using Services for benefit of third party.
tos_analysis.assignment: Neither party may assign without prior written consent (except in merger/acquisition). Attempted assignment without consent is null and void.
tos_analysis.third_party_benefit: Expressly prohibited: cannot sublicense or use Fly.io Services for the benefit of a third party.
tos_analysis.managed_services_note: Managed Postgres appears in documentation as a product feature, not as a reseller/managed service wrapper permission for customers.

risks: No permanent free tier — trial-only model violates zero-capital sustainability requirement
Explicit prohibition on sublicensing and third-party benefit blocks any resale or managed service wrapper
License restricted to internal use only
Assignment requires written consent from Fly.io
No enterprise/reseller exception found in public TOS
next_steps: REJECTED — do not proceed to TIER1
